register_io_source_custom_reader: register a custom io source function that returns an iterator of DataFrames with a specified schema for lazy evaluation
register_io_source_pure: register a pure io source to enable lazyframe plan deduplication during query optimization
register_io_source_with_predicate: register an io source that supports column projection, row filtering via predicates, row limits, and batch size hints
defer_dataframe_execution: defer execution of a function producing a DataFrame until the lazyframe is collected
defer_database_query_cloud: defer a database read operation and chain filter, sum, and remote execution on the resulting lazyframe
